subject: [PATCH v2 10/10] mm/madvise: share cold and pageout walk setup

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch refactors the shared mmu_gather and page-walk sequence in madvise_cold() and madvise_pageout(). The common sequence is moved into a new function, madvise_lru_vma_range(), which takes a flag indicating whether to perform a pageout. This change simplifies the code and reduces duplication. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
